from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def fetch_all_recommendations(access_token, page_limit=20):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
        print('page_index',page_index,'count',len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    return all_items

recs=fetch_all_recommendations(spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print('total_recommendations',len(recs))
# build frequency counter across all artists in each song
artist_names=[]
for item in recs:
    for a in (item.get('artists') or []):
        artist_names.append(a.get('name'))

counter=Counter(artist_names)
print('unique_artists',len(counter))
print('artist_counts',dict(counter.most_common(20)))
# tiebreaker: first appearance order then alphabetical
first_seen={}
for i,item in enumerate(recs):
    for a in (item.get('artists') or []):
        name=a.get('name')
        if name not in first_seen:
            first_seen[name]=i

min_count=min(counter.values())
least=[name for name,c in counter.items() if c==min_count]
print('min_count',min_count,'least_candidates',least)
# sort by first_seen then alphabetical
least_sorted=sorted(least, key=lambda n:(first_seen.get(n,10**18), n))
print('least_selected',least_sorted[0])
